rules.guardrail1Desc: Kumaran Chits operates solely for Kumaran Finance (Perundurai). Zero company_id columns exist.
rules.guardrail2Desc: All financial values use integer BigInt Rupees. Paise, decimals (.00), and floating-point math are strictly prohibited.
rules.guardrail3Desc: Foreman commission is fixed at 4.00% and permanently frozen per chit group upon creation.
rules.guardrail4Desc: Auction dividend is distributed equally to ALL members (including the current winner and past prized winners). Everyone pays Net = Base - Dividend next month.
rules.guardrail5Desc: No auctions take place in Month 1 (full pool taken by company) or Month N (final subscriber settlement with 4% commission). Auctions occur exclusively in Months 2 through N-1.
rules.guardrail6Desc: Auction discount cannot exceed 25% (1/4 of total chit value). Multiple ceiling bids trigger the Foreman to physically draw paper lot tokens in front of members.
rules.guardrail7Desc: A subscriber can join multiple chit groups, but cannot hold 2 or more tickets in the same chit group.
rules.guardrail8Desc: Unpaid current due blocks auction bidding. Each month accepts strictly one discrete payment matching exact net due (zero partial/advance).
rules.guardrail9Desc: Flexible safety checklist: signed blank cheques, agreements, and promissory notes. Property collateral is completely eliminated.
rules.guardrail10Desc: The person initiating an auction, voucher, handover, or reversal cannot authorize it. Strict dual control is enforced at database and UI levels.
